ideaStatement: Identify and implement a safe fix for recurring apply_patch context failures, then verify, commit, merge, push, and confirm green CI without hiding or overwriting unrelated work.

decisions.question: What is the fix boundary?
decisions.answer: Improve patch-application reliability and diagnostics in the repository/agent workflow; do not weaken exact-context verification or silently overwrite files.
decisions.rationale: The observed failures are context mismatches, and fail-closed editing is a safety invariant.
traceability: Repository apply_patch failures in current session and recorded logs

decisions.question: What is the source of truth for changes?
decisions.answer: Current repository files and git diff are authoritative; stale snippets, truncated tool output, and generated copies must be re-read before patching.
decisions.rationale: The recurring error occurs when patch context is based on an earlier or incomplete file view.

decisions.question: How should delivery be handled?
decisions.answer: Use bounded implementation, independent review, repository gates, an explicit path-only commit, remote integration, push, and GitHub CI verification.
decisions.rationale: The requested outcome includes build delivery and CI, while unrelated changes must remain protected.

researchSynthesis: Recurring apply_patch failures are caused by exact-context drift: long JSON lines, formatter rewrites, concurrent edits, stale copied snippets, and patches aimed at the wrong repository or file shape. The fix must preserve fail-closed context matching while making the workflow more reliable through fresh bounded reads, stable anchors, smaller hunks, explicit file ownership, conflict diagnostics, and tests for stale/format-shifted/concurrent contexts. The implementation must be repository-specific and must not invent a replacement editor that bypasses the existing safety boundary.

phases.title: Prepare patch reliability work
phases.goal: Build the smallest safe reliability improvement from the recorded patch failures.
constraints: Use current file contents and git evidence
Keep path and ownership boundaries explicit
context: Relevant local examples are recorded in the repository process evidence.
The fix must account for long-line JSON and concurrent formatter/agent changes.
The host supplies the validated progress-followups plan as the build input.

phases.title: Implement bounded patch reliability fix
phases.goal: Implement the selected fix without weakening fail-closed editing or overwriting unrelated work.
constraints: Every changed file has an acceptance signal
context: Prefer smaller stable hunks and explicit re-read/anchor diagnostics over fuzzy application.
Keep generated payloads synchronized if the selected seam is packaged.

phases.title: Verify patch reliability work
phases.goal: Build verification evidence for the change and repair any material failure.
constraints: Reviewer did not author the implementation
No commit until review and gates pass
context: Verification must include long JSON lines, formatter drift, concurrent edits, generated payload parity, and exact error reporting.

phases.title: Commit merge push and confirm CI
phases.goal: Deliver the verified fix through the repository's hook, remote integration, and CI workflow.
constraints: Verify CI by run URL and conclusion
context: Use gh for CI inspection and report the final commit, merge, push, and run URL.
